item.title: Cofferly 0.5.3
item.description: - **Drag a card onto a board's tab to add it there,** or several cards you've picked with ⌘-click: the tab lights up under the pointer, and ⌘Z takes it back. Dragged from one board to another, the cards move. - **Put cards in your own order by dragging them,** in any tab and on your boards. A new copy goes on top, a search shows its matches newest first, and Newest First in the tab's menu brings back the usual order. With VoiceOver: Move Earlier, Move Later and Move to Board. - **Search with dates the way you say them,** such as "last weekend", "past 3 days" or "middle of last month". - **More room for your boards on the tab bar:** as many boards show by name as fit, and the rest are under More. When it fills up, Text, Images, Links, Files and Sensitive show only their icons first; choose in Settings › General › Tab titles. - **A copy from an app you excluded stays out,** also when you switch to another app right after copying. - **Locking your Mac while Cofferly is unlocking now keeps Cofferly locked,** and it asks for Touch ID again. - **Shortcuts reads your items only if you let it:** Get Recent Items and Copy an Item now work once you turn on "Let Shortcuts read your items" in Settings › Privacy. - **Updates always ask before they install:** no other app or setting can make Cofferly download and install an update by itself when you quit. - **Links in your items and previews open only if they're web links:** a link to a file or another app does nothing. - **Your recovery key stays out of screen sharing and recordings** while Cofferly shows it. - **The Accessibility request says what it's for:** pasting with ⌘V, and Suggested reading the field you type in, never a password field, and nothing leaves your Mac. - **Copies made while Cofferly was locked are kept, even when this version can't read them,** and Cofferly tells you so when it unlocks: a newer version probably made them.
